searchText: Happy Thanksgiving to my fellow Americans. **AllCoreDevs call in ~21.5hrs (Nov 27 14:00 UTC)** **Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/224** **Stream: https://youtu.be/UGyqRoLwq1o** Also worth highlighting that <@!301186049323958275> has shared a few writeups on the various issues & potential path forwards for the Berlin EIPs: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/224#issuecomment-734067687 It's time for summer mate ? I'd like to do an experiment with video-encouraged ACD meetings. I think it could help consensus formation if more people were on video. Is anyone willing to join me in having their video on for the call tomorrow? If so react here with 🎥 https://twitter.com/peter_szilagyi/status/1332047468004077569?s=09 is it a call to go and try? 🙂 Separate question: was it ever considered or tested whether some part of block data or the block encoding as a whole is worth to compress? Would like to avoid experimenting if it was measured before
